business: The Monitoring Gap 2026, a research report published by Stell, a fictional six-person independent freshwater data unit. Its subject is storm-overflow monitoring: sewage discharges are counted by monitors, the counts are what everybody quotes, and a monitor that is offline records an absence rather than a zero. The report joins the spill counts to the monitor-availability figures across twelve catchments and sixty months and shows that published figures track how much of the estate was working rather than how much sewage reached the river. Every catchment and every figure is simulated and the report says so on its own front page. Its audience is environment reporters, catchment partnerships, regulators and the people who live on these rivers.
directionLabel: Report — a measure, a margin, and its apparatus showing
